entities.name: Corsen Mon Duur
entities.description: Long-bearded dwarf summoned by a planeswalker and left behind.

entities.name: Dreadfang
entities.description: Kobold who captured Corsen's kin to lure Loot.

entities.name: Loot Niptil
entities.description: Nameless being Dreadfang wanted to retrieve cursed armor.

entities.name: Anaytha
entities.description: Woman at the complex who looked like Loot.

entities.name: Kyyrao Grrenmw
entities.description: Cat warrior who knelt with Corsen.

entities.name: Shinra
entities.description: Cat warrior who knelt with Corsen.

entities.name: Peregrinator Complex
entities.description: Complex holding the treasure and cursed armor.

events.summary: Corsen is summoned to a planeswalker duel and left behind when his planeswalker loses.
events.quote: Corsen was summoned to fight in a Planeswalker duel and was left behind when his planeswalker lost

events.summary: Dreadfang captures Corsen's brother and nephew to force him to lure Loot.
events.quote: the kobold Dreadfang captured Corsen’s brother and nephew

events.summary: Corsen finds Loot and tells him of Anaytha, who looks like Loot.
events.quote: he told Loot that he had been attacked by kobolds at the Peregrinator Complex

events.summary: Loot attacks Dreadfang, who is soon dead; the party leaves the complex.
events.quote: Dreadfang did not believe, but was soon dead.

relations.quote: the kobold Dreadfang captured Corsen’s brother and nephew
